title: [SA, NSW, QLD] Free TAFE Courses Giving Certificates and Microcredentials

[mantichoral] The SA TAFE AI course is self-paced. It did not take me ten hours. (In general, I found most of these courses far quicker to finish than the given durations. But I cannot speak for the average Ozbargain reader - or for the average Ozbargain commenter.)
You can do multiple courses with TAFE SA if you pay for them - this is the only free course there that I could find.
After finishing the course, I still have my email address.
[mantichoral] Note that the 'free TAFE' courses in Victoria are what everyone else calls 'fee-free' - quoting them:
"Free TAFE means you don’t pay the tuition fees.
Each TAFE or course may have additional student fees for student services and/or course materials fees. You should ask your preferred TAFE for information about additional fees."
But these free online courses can be taken by anyone in any state, territory, or country around the world. Because they're online, and free.

These short courses are not fulltime, and are not degrees.
You can enrol for degrees at TAFE, which will grant you student status, e.g.

[tenpercent] @mantichoral: What on earth is the difference between free and fee-free?

[mantichoral] @tenpercent: 'Free' means 'obtained by paying no money at all' (in this context, free as in beer, not free as in liberty).
'Fee-free' means that that the tuition fee is waived for a course, but there may be other fees associated with the course for student services or for course materials. So, a smaller payment results. It is a marketing term; one fee has been removed, but not all fees.
Except in Victoria, as I explained above, 'fee-free' is marketed as 'free'. So you could look at that link to TAFE Victoria 'free' courses and reasonably conclude that 'free' costs money. I did not recommend courses from TAFE Victoria for this reason. I understand that this is what is known locally as 'spruiking a rort,' and it speaks to the character of the Victorian government.
I hold badges in communications and have an IELTS score of 9.0, achieved for immigration purposes. My communication skills are truly excellent, and hold a well-deserved position on my resume.

On a more serious note, thank you. That explains the difference in marketing terminology.
